title: Deal, quote, accepted, invoice ready to send
summary: From a qualified canary client to a draft invoice behind its send approval: a deal, a quote with a line, the customer accepting (the CRM marks the deal won), the accepted quote turned into a draft invoice and the send routed to the Reviewer first. Billing does not convert an accepted quote by itself, and since Billing 0.7.2 it opens no "Deal won" task for the canary client, so the journey reads the quote and converts it itself unless something already has (the run is the canary, so the Billing action is allowed). It stops at the approval: only a person approves a send, and the run cancels the canary's own approval (and a Deal won task, if one was ever opened) afterwards. The payment proof leg waits for Billing to record a canary payment without a person (see the README).

steps.title: Find the canary client
steps.note: Make this call NOW with exactly the input above (it carries this run's id, which the answer must echo): an answer from an earlier call, or from the previous journey, is stale because that journey's last step removed the canary.

steps.title: Add a line to the quote
The CRM marked the deal won
steps.note: The CRM marks the deal won when the quote is accepted. If total is 0, wait 30 seconds and ask again once before recording.

steps.title: The accepted quote is converted to an invoice
steps.note: Billing does NOT convert an accepted quote by itself. For a real client it may open a "Deal won" task for the Account Manager, which converts it; for the canary client Billing opens none, so expect the quote to still be accepted. Read the quote with quote-detail. If quote.status is accepted, call partnersinbiz.billing:convert-quote with the same quoteId (the run is the canary, so this Billing action is allowed) and record ITS answer: it carries the same quote fields. If quote.status is already converted (a Deal won task got there first), record the quote-detail answer and use its convertedInvoiceId. If convert-quote refuses because the quote was converted meanwhile, read quote-detail again and record that. Do not wait for Billing to convert it, and do not assert that it does.

steps.title: The invoice is a draft with the quote's total and the deal
The invoice send approval reaches the Reviewer first
steps.note: Read the invoice with invoice-detail. If invoice.pendingAction is not send, or approvalIssueId is empty (no Deal won task asked for the send), call partnersinbiz.billing:request-invoice-send with this invoiceId and sendTo canary@canary.invalid, then read invoice-detail again and record that answer. Do NOT approve the approval, do not touch it: the Cockpit checks where it went and cancels the canary's approval when the run ends.
